designDecisions.claim: Settings assets/factories/visibility/routes remain registration and composition responsibilities. The 48 workflow facades are coarse caller proposals supported by their enumerated operations, not 48 recovered packages.
MENU-UNIT-application-menu owns menu composition. Integrate all16 callback adapter proposals without assigning the whole CZe function to each feature or transferring service state into main menus.

Draft preparation and context selection stay separate from actual thread start/submit/cancel. Conditional manager/provider joins apply only to the five saved consumers; they do not make the provider facade the UI owner.
Archive presentation aggregates typed local-host, cloud-task and account-conversation sources. Reuse the local archive workflow for its menu alias while preserving distinct state/effect adapters.
Keep browser page history, application router history and adjacent-thread list navigation as three separate contracts; a back/forward label does not establish equivalent state ownership.

Workspace menu aliases and the later full-view operation reuse MPA-M02. Their appearance in multiple menu batches does not create multiple layout controllers or prove injected layout-provider ownership.
MVR-M01 owns the proposed banner/subscription lifecycle; injected actual zoom callbacks remain a separate authority. Preserve page-only numeric accelerators and ordinary page-then-window fallback.

MVR-M02 owns the proposed local open/toggle controller. The named lazy dialog, mount location and error UI remain explicit dependency boundaries rather than an inferred complete shortcut feature implementation.

UI preference/config mutation intent is separate from authoritative host/account stores, effective roots and durable flush/migration. Carry these exact operation contracts into SQ-04 rather than inventing persistence in each page.

Unknown-mode workflows remain in scope. Apply the existing three Chat-only branch decisions at their saved boundaries; names such as chat, archive or account do not justify deleting entire shared workflows.
Third-party implementations remain package/runtime/adapter dependencies. Generic coverage hints do not choose versions, establish upstream equivalence or authorize copying helper implementations.

Project menu command/dialog orchestration is separate from the existing project domain/provider contracts. Keep project selection, registration and state consumers connected through explicit ports; a same-domain name is not a verified provider join.

dependencyPolicy.rule: Use package/runtime/explicit adapter boundaries. A dependency planning hint does not establish its installed version or replacement qualification.

remaining: SQ-02 source census beyond the delivered menu interval, including CZe record33 and other menu/command/navigation owners.
SQ-04 storage-domain/feature authority joins; keep native/backend-internal effects as explicit external boundaries.
Per-feature authoritative provider identity, actual receiver/postcondition and failure/cancel/restart acceptance.
Dependency/runtime provenance and independent clean build/package qualification.
Mode-specific caller/dependency closure; unknown does not permit whole-feature exclusion.
